project_type: React + TypeScript + Vite frontend with Capacitor native shell (social media platform called Aurelix/Parallax)
build_system: Vite with bun as package manager
test_framework: Vitest with jsdom environment, @testing-library/react, setup file at src/test/setup.ts
verification_instructions: 1) Run 'bunx tsc --noEmit' to check TypeScript. 2) Run 'bun run build' to confirm Vite build succeeds. 3) Run 'bun run test -- --run' to confirm tests pass.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Supabase project is live at https://ijkxadnmeqfflfuwvmfz.supabase.co. Cloudinary cloud name: dxoqepdck, upload preset: ml_default
contribution_requirements: Work on a new branch (feat/migrate-firebase-to-supabase). Do not fix pre-existing lint errors (368 known). Do not break existing 33 tests.
key_patterns: Supabase client at src/integrations/supabase/client.ts uses Database type from src/types/supabase.ts. Cloudinary utility already exists at src/lib/cloudinary.ts with uploadToCloudinary function. AuthProvider exposes user/profile/session via React context. Firebase Firestore is used for social features (posts, likes, comments, stories, follows, wallets, transactions, notifications, unread_counts). Firebase Auth handles email/password and Google sign-in. Firebase Storage used only for avatar uploads in ProfileCreation.tsx.
directory_structure: src/lib/ (utilities, firebase config, cloudinary), src/contexts/ (AuthProvider, CallProvider), src/hooks/ (Firebase-dependent hooks), src/pages/ (routes - Auth, Discover, ProfileCreation, admin-os/), src/components/ (social/, layout/, wallet/, creator/), src/integrations/supabase/ (Supabase client), src/services/ (platform services), src/types/ (supabase types), src/test/ (test setup)
